# Armbrust American

> > Independent mask testing laboratory and US-based respirator manufacturer providing filtration testing data for N95, KN95, KF94, and surgical masks.

Armbrust American conducts comprehensive third-party testing of respiratory protection products using PFE (particulate filtration efficiency) machines and ASTM standards, while also manufacturing American-made masks and offering elastomeric respirator solutions. The site features hundreds of mask reviews, safety guidelines, and investor relations for their US manufacturing operations.

## Key Topics

- N95 respirators
- KN95 respirators
- KF94 masks
- Surgical masks
- PFE (Particulate Filtration Efficiency) testing
- ASTM filtration standards
- Meltblown filtration material
- NIOSH certification
- FDA regulatory compliance
- Breathability testing
- Respiratory protection
- US mask manufacturing
- Elastomeric respirators
- Mask fitters and braces
- Failed mask identification
